title: Jim Semivan of the CIA briefed that psi and mind-matter connection are real

tellings.quote: tangentially related to UFOs. And they say that the size stuff, the parasychology, the idea that mind and matter are not, you know, partitioned, they're connected, is the kind of real core truth. All of that is real.

plain: A CIA officer named Jim Semivan and others are said to hold that psychic abilities are real and that mind and matter are not separate but connected, and that this is the "real core truth" tied to UFOs. Michels says this himself, without naming where he heard it, in an episode with the researcher Grant Cameron. If true, it would mean people inside the CIA see the mind as central to the UFO question.
